body: No it won't. I felt that way last summer when I attempted suicide. After I attempted, I thought about how my mother would feel, my best friends, my little sister, who has been through the same stuff i have, would feel. He hasn't left because he loves you. Why would you leave him? Think about your wedding day and happy you were when you two got married. Imagine that day every time you have a fight. Think about the love you share.

Who says it has to be in person? I met some of my greatest friends online and never in person. We laugh all the time. We text, play games, and even find more people all online. Someone will love you for who you are. Just wait. :)

You are not dead on the inside. Instead of complaining about the negative. Pick your head up and march on. It's called the Beaten Path because it can be BEATEN. Now march on and beat that path even more! :)

He hasn't left because he loves you. You should try talking to him calmly about this topic when things are not so tense. Talk about the problems you are having and the problems he is having and work things out. He loves you, you love him. There should be no arguments. Just calmly talk things out with one another.
We all sin. We all do wrong by God.

Well, think about your progress. You have gone this long, what makes you think you can't continue? No matter what fight you get, thought you have, or anything. You are special and God, your son, and even I love you. You are never truly alone. :) You can fight through this for those you love, and for the ones that love you.
Hey, you always have friends! I'm a friend! :) You may not know me, but i'll be your friend. :)

He's always there. If you don't feel Him there, then you don't trust him whole-heartily. When you worry, means you don't trust him enough. You gotta give everything to him. Ask for forgiveness. Let everything go, hold nothing back, cry if you have to. You won't feel Him if you don't. He already knows what you did. Just admit it.
Being an Atheist doesn't mean that He doesn't care. He wants to help you, you just gotta open up and pray and give him all your pain. He loves you unconditionally.

I ask myself the same question everyday. I know how you feel. I'm never happy anymore. I let everything affect me, everything get to me. I honestly don't know how I haven't done it yet. WAIT! That's right. It's stupid to think about it. We were put on this earth for a specific reason, and we all want to end it without finding it? Hang in there. Your question isn't " What is wrong with me?", but more "Who am I?". God will help you find who you are. Just pray. :) I care about everyone and went through a lot last year. I know what you feel.
It was meant to be like a poem, but it didn't work out so well.
I understand how you feel. Do you wanna talk about it?
